acceptanceCriteria: Path screening no longer flags hyphenated lower-case word sequences such as sk-1022p-site-knowledge-setup while real sk- key shapes are still refused.
A focused secretscreen test covers both; it fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane sk-1022p (PR beamfall/corvint#1548, seal 6879bb81e). The build-log path 2026-10-22-sk-1022p-site-knowledge-setup.md matched the internal/secretscreen pattern \bsk-[a-z0-9_-]{20,} and dogfood failed with local-outcome secret-shaped-path. Ordinary hyphenated words after sk- are not key material.
title: Secret screen flags lane-prefixed file names starting sk- as API keys and fails dogfood local-outcome
